comment: Third-party components compiled into the engine release bundles, other than Rust crates (those are generated into crates/). Each licenseFiles entry is a repository-relative file holding a full licence text; scripts/engine_notices.py copies them into each bundle's LICENSES/ folder. Add a component here, and its id to the bundle's 'notices' list in engines/bundles.json, whenever a build starts linking new third-party code.

softhsmv3.name: SoftHSMv3, the PQC Today fork of SoftHSM2
softhsmv3.modified: OpenSSL 3 EVP-only backend, PKCS#11 v3.2, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, HSS/LMS, XMSS; see LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md

hash-sigs.name: hash-sigs (HSS/LMS), PQC Today fork of cisco/hash-sigs
hash-sigs.modified: SP 800-208 SHAKE-256 parameter sets and OpenSSL hashing, by PQC Today

emscripten-runtime.name: Emscripten runtime (emscripten library code, musl libc, libc++, libc++abi, compiler-rt)
emscripten-runtime.version: Emscripten SDK used for the build (texts from emsdk 6.0.4)
emscripten-runtime.license: (MIT OR NCSA) AND MIT AND (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR NCSA OR MIT)

openssh.name: OpenSSH portable
openssh.license: LicenseRef-OpenSSH (BSD-style and ISC terms, see the text)
copyright: Tatu Ylonen, the OpenBSD project and the other authors named in the licence text
openssh.modified: ML-DSA and SLH-DSA key types and PKCS#11 signing, by PQC Today, LLC; see openssh-pkcs11/NOTICE

strongswan.name: strongSwan
copyright: The strongSwan authors and secunet Security Networks AG, see the headers of the source files
strongswan.modified: PQC Today, LLC patches: strongswan-6.0.5-pqc.patch, strongswan-6.0.5-wasm.patch, the strongswan-pkcs11/ plugin and strongswan-wasm-shims/, applied by scripts/build-strongswan-wasm.sh
strongswan.sourceOffer: Complete corresponding source: the strongSwan 6.0.5 tarball above plus {repo}/tree/{commit} (patches, plugin, shims and build script). It stays available there, and on request from PQC Today, LLC, for at least three years after this bundle is published.

pkcs11-provider.name: pkcs11-provider (OpenSSL 3 provider), PQC Today fork
copyright: Copyright (C) 2022 Simo Sorce and the pkcs11-provider contributors
pkcs11-provider.modified: modified by PQC Today, LLC; see src/vendor/pkcs11-provider/PATCHES.md

openssl-cli.name: OpenSSL, library and openssl command-line tool
openssl-cli.source: https://www.openssl.org/source/openssl-3.6.3.tar.gz (SHA-256 243a86649cf6f23eeb6a2ff2456e09e5d77dd9018a54d3d96b0c6bdd6ba6c7f1); built with its apps by scripts/build-openssl-studio-wasm.sh
openssl-cli.modified: apps/openssl.c changed by PQC Today, LLC to register pkcs11-provider at start-up; see wasm/openssl-studio/patches/0001-apps_startup-register-pkcs11-provider.patch

openssl-studio-shims.name: OpenSSL Studio shims (TLS, CMP and CMS simulators, static PKCS#11 binding)
openssl-studio-shims.source: wasm/openssl-studio/ in this repository (see its README.md)
openssl-studio-shims.sourceOffer: Complete corresponding source: {repo}/tree/{commit} (shims, OpenSSL patch and build script) plus the OpenSSL 3.6.3 tarball and the pkcs11-provider source named in this file. It stays available there, and on request from PQC Today, LLC, for at least three years after this bundle is published.
